Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Jobomschrijving

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
• You are available for a full-time position.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager - Hunter (Pharmaceutical Laboratory Services) - Europe
jobs.description:
Your mission: WIN NEW BUSINESS!      You will take ownership of new client acquisition in the European (bio)pharmaceutical market.    Your primary goal is to build a strong pipeline, engage decisionmakers and win new contracts for our    QC laboratory services.    You combine disciplined prospecting with consultative selling and confidently drive opportunities from first contact through negotiation and contract signature.
   
• Identify, target and acquire new customers in the European (bio)pharmaceutical sector, with a focus on companies developing and manufacturing small and/or large molecules.  
• Build and execute a proactive account acquisition plan, including cold outreach, networking, referrals, industry events and strategic partnerships.  
• Create and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline and take full ownership of opportunities from lead generation to closing.  
• Lead negotiations, overcome objections and close profitable contracts in line with commercial targets.  
• Represent SGS Pharma laboratory services at conventions, exhibitions, professional associations and targeted networking events.  
• Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity stages, next actions and forecasts. 

What do you need to be successful in this role?
   
• A bachelor's or master's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences or a related field.  
• At least 3 years of successful sales or business development experience in the pharmaceutical industry, ideally within laboratory, analytical, QC, CDMO/CRO or related services.  
• Good knowledge of regulatory QC requirements, including GMP and FDA expectations.  
• Consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills, combined with a strong focus on measurable commercial results.  
• You stay focused through long sales cycles and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.  
• An entrepreneurial and structured working style, with strong CRM discipline  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.    Additional European languages are an advantage.  
This is a position for someone who wants to have a real impact on business growth.    You will have the freedom to develop new markets and customers while being backed by experienced experts.
 
You can focus on building relationships, identifying opportunities and closing businesses, while working in a scientific environment where quality, expertise and reliability are key.

Your mandate: execution, ownership and results 
You will personally lead the on-site execution of a major industrial project while overseeing several others, with individual projects worth several million euros. Your responsibility extends from site mobilisation and execution through handover and contractual and financial close-out.
 
This is neither a design-engineering position nor a remote project oversight role. You will be close to the work, teams, subcontractors and customers — while maintaining control of safety, quality, deadlines, budgets, margins and contractual commitments.
 Where you will make the difference  
• Deliver on site. Set execution priorities, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and subcontractors, resolve operational issues and ensure safe, high-quality delivery. 
• Protect project performance. Own budgets, forecasts, costs, cash flow and margins; spot deviations early and act before they affect results. 
• Manage contractual complexity. Anticipate risks, handle variations and claims, contribute to negotiations and safeguard customer relationships, including in public-sector projects. 
• Lead and develop people. Guide a team of approximately five to six project professionals, building accountability, confidence and stronger project practices. 
• Create clarity. Use practical planning, reporting and project reviews to turn complex situations into timely decisions — without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 
• At least 7 years managing complex industrial projects, including substantial, hands-on responsibility for on-site execution. 
• At least 3 years in project management roles, with proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams. 
• Strong financial and contractual judgement: budgets, margins, forecasts, risk, negotiation and claims. 
• A sound technical foundation, ideally in mechanical, electromechanical, civil or industrial engineering; other educational backgrounds are welcome with substantial relevant experience. 
•  Fluent French and English; basic Dutch is an advantage. Experience with public procurement is particularly valuable.  
Above all, you enjoy the reality of industrial sites. You are pragmatic, structured and decisive; you can challenge technical choices, understand their commercial consequences and bring people with you.

As an integral part of the Human Resources Department, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our internship program at Robert Bosch and Bosch Home Comfort in Belgium. Your responsibilities will include:

• Recruitment Process Management: Take charge of the recruitment process for all internship positions, from updating job descriptions to actively managing candidate outreach and screening.

• Intern Support: Act as the HR Business Partner for our interns, maintaining communication with them and their mentors while addressing any HR-related inquiries.

• Small HR Projects: Get involved in soft HR projects that enhance the overall employee experience across the company.

• Administrative Excellence: Assist our compensation and benefits coordinators with HR management and payroll topics, while also supporting the team with various administrative tasks.

Why Join Us?

• Hands-On Experience: This is your chance to gain practical experience in HR, working alongside seasoned professionals in a supportive environment.

• Networking Opportunities: Build connections with industry leaders and fellow interns, paving the way for future career opportunities.

• Professional Development: Enhance your skills in recruitment, communication, and HR management, setting a strong foundation for your future career.

Who We're Looking For:

• You are currently a student in Business, Psychology, or Human Resources related fields.

• Ideally, you have gained some practical experience and are confident in working with MS Office.

• You possess excellent communication skills and can work effectively under tight deadlines.

• As a self-starter, you are entrepreneurial and able to work autonomously, always eager to find solutions.

• You are stress-resistant and flexible, adapting to the dynamic needs of the team.

• Fluency in English is essential, and a good knowledge of Dutch and/or French and/or German is highly valued.

 

Don't worry if you don't meet every single requirement—if you're passionate about HR and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply! Your unique perspective and enthusiasm could be įust what we're looking for. We are looking forward to receiving your application in English. Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further questions.

jobs.occupation: ESG & Impact Officer - International Exposure - Brussels
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans
• Monitor ESG performance and impact outcomes throughout the investment lifecycle
• Strengthen ESG policies, frameworks, tools, and internal processes
• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications
• Coordinate third-party ESG and impact assessments
• Represent the organization at industry events and ESG-related initiatives

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, International Development, Political Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline
• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Direct contacts with companies
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets
• Solid knowledge of ESG risk assessment methodologies
• Experience reviewing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
• Understanding of impact measurement frameworks, SDGs, Theory of Change, or similar approaches
• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English
